turns.user_utterance: My card's frozen, what can I do?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when you say your card is frozen, do you mean it was blocked for security (e.g., suspicious activity) or that it’s not working due to a PIN/cash withdrawal issue? If you can, tell me what you tried right before it happened (payment, cash withdrawal, or ATM).

turns.user_utterance: I was at an ATM trying to get cash and it got rejected.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if the ATM rejected your cash withdrawal, the likely issue is a declined cash withdrawal. Please tell me: did you see any error message on the ATM (e.g., “declined”, “try again”, “transaction failed”)? Also, did the ATM take the cash/your card, or did it keep your card?
